# Khin Eaindray Htun - AI & Data Portfolio

This customized portfolio combines:
- minimal neobrutalism
- light paper-like background
- restrained sage accent
- handwritten annotations
- sketch-style arrows and doodles
- hard borders/shadows
- recruiter-friendly data portfolio structure

## Files
- `index.html` — content and page structure
- `journey.html` — separate expandable life-journey timeline
- `style.css` — theme and responsive design
- `article.css` — publication-article layout
- `script.js` — project filtering and Chart.js chart
- `articles/` — complete long-form publication and project pages
- `README.md` — setup notes

## Run
Double-click `index.html`, or open the folder in VS Code and use **Live Server**.

## Included content
- Khin Eaindray Htun's name, profile, education, experience, and skills
- Twenty projects; personal work is shown first, with paid and job projects available on demand
- GitHub, LinkedIn, email, and a downloadable one-page résumé
- Project filtering and a portfolio skill-coverage chart on the main page
- A separate expandable life-journey page for education, work, publications, competitions, and community milestones
- Newspaper-style articles for the published EEG brain-computer-interface chapter and the Ezria senior project

## Still worth adding
- Public URLs or case studies for projects

## Design system
The main colors are at the top of `style.css` under `:root`.

The handwritten font is **Caveat**, while the main UI uses **Inter**.

## Design principle
Use handwriting as annotation, not body text. Keep:
- titles
- data
- metrics
- navigation
- project descriptions

in the clean sans-serif font.

Use handwritten notes only for:
- comments
- arrows
- callouts
- tiny human observations
- labels around diagrams
